Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (''Listing Regulations'') read with Part A of Schedule III and SEBI Master Circular No. HO/49/14/14(7)2025-CFD-POD2/I/3762/2026 dated January 30, 2026 and further to our intimation dated August 21, 2026, we would like to inform the exchanges that the Goods & Service Tax Department, Maharashtra (Commissioner of State Tax) have concluded their inspection/ search proceedings on August 26, 2026. 

The details required under Listing Regulations read with aforesaid SEBI Master Circular is enclosed herewith as an "Annexure-A."

Pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (''Listing Regulations'') read with Part A of Schedule III and SEBI Master Circular No. HO/49/14/14(7)2025-CFD-POD2/I/3762/2026 dated January 30, 2026, we would like to inform the exchanges that the Company has received show cause notice (DRC 01) from "Deputy Commissioner of State Tax, CT & GST Circle, Balasore, Odisha, under Section 74 of the CGST Act, 2017 & OGST Act, 2017 on August 31, 2026 at 11:50 a.m. (IST).

Pursuant to SEBI Circular No. HO/38/13/11(2)2026-MIRSD-POD/I/3750/2026 dated January 30, 2026, please find enclosed the copy of the advertisement published in newspapers viz. Financial Express (All editions) and Deshdoot (Nashik Edition) on September 1, 2026 regarding special window for re-lodgement of transfer requests and dematerialisation of physical shares.
